description: Vungle (Liftoff) ad SDK across all three package generations: current com.vungle.ads (7.x, artifact com.vungle:vungle-ads), legacy com.vungle.warren (Vungle SDK 6.x 'Warren', artifact com.vungle:publisher-sdk-android 6.x) and older com.vungle.publisher (SDK 4.x/5.x, same artifact). Warren 6.x has no InterstitialAd/RewardedAd classes: full-screen interstitial and rewarded ads are driven by the static com.vungle.warren.Vungle facade (init/loadAd/playAd/canPlayAd); banners go through com.vungle.warren.Banners and native ads through com.vungle.warren.NativeAd. SDK 4.x/5.x centres on the com.vungle.publisher.VunglePub singleton. Real apps still ship the old SDKs (e.g. Bad Piggies HD bundles com.vungle.warren, 587 classes).

methods.name: init
methods.note: Legacy 6.x (Warren) main init; 3 static void overloads (String/Collection key, Context, InitCallback[, VungleSettings]); the InitCallback never fires once stubbed, which keeps the app from starting ad ops. isInitialized() then returns false on its own

methods.name: init
methods.note: Legacy 4.x/5.x init; instance method init(Context, String appId, String[] placements, VungleInitListener) (plus 4.x Context/String[] overloads), all void; the VungleInitListener never fires once stubbed. VunglePub.getInstance() itself is protected (see protected_patterns)

methods.name: loadAd
methods.note: Legacy 6.x interstitial/rewarded load; 3 static void overloads (String[,String],[AdConfig],LoadAdCallback)

methods.name: playAd
methods.note: Legacy 6.x interstitial/rewarded show; 2 static void overloads (String[,String],AdConfig,PlayAdCallback)

methods.name: setIncentivizedFields
methods.note: Sets rewarded-ad user metadata (user id / titles / body / button text); void

methods.name: loadBanner
methods.note: Legacy 6.x banner load; 3 static void overloads (String[,String],AdSize|BannerAdConfig,LoadAdCallback)

methods.name: getBanner
methods.note: 3 static overloads returning com.vungle.warren.VungleBanner; documented @Nullable (returns null when no ad is cached), so callers already null-check. Safe to null now that loadBanner is stubbed

methods.name: loadAd
methods.note: Legacy 6.x native ad load; 2 instance void overloads (AdConfig[,String],NativeAdListener)

methods.name: isAdPlayable
methods.note: Legacy 4.x/5.x instance isAdPlayable(String) -> boolean (4.x also has a no-arg overload)

manifest_components.note: Legacy 6.x (Warren) full-screen ad activity (present in Bad Piggies HD and every publisher-sdk-android 6.9.1-6.12.1 manifest)
Legacy 6.x auto-init ContentProvider (authority ${applicationId}.vungle-provider) used to grab the application Context at startup; present in every 6.9.1-6.12.1 manifest and in Bad Piggies HD
Legacy 6.x CONNECTIVITY_CHANGE receiver that resumes downloads/reporting when the network returns (6.9.x manifest; dropped in 6.12.x)

protected_patterns.reason: Static getInstance() returns the @NonNull VunglePub singleton that the app then calls init/loadAd/playAd on; returning null would NPE at the first dereference. Its ad traffic is cut off by stubbing the instance methods (init/loadAd/playAd) instead
Returns the @NonNull global AdConfig object the app configures (setters) before/after init; null would NPE. Harmless once init is stubbed

Vungle.isInitialized() / VunglePub.isInitialized() return a boolean that is naturally false once init is stubbed; leave them working so callers correctly see the SDK as not initialised rather than being forced true
